name: Gas-Station Sushi
text: A tray of gas-station sushi with a sticker that says FRESH, written three times in three different pens. Your stomach says no. Your stomach has been wrong before. Never in your favor, but it has.

dumb.label: Eat the whole tray
dumb.text: Heal 25 HP; 35% chance to start the next fight with Hungover for 3 turns.
